# Breakout

The player moves a paddle along the bottom of the screen to keep a ball in play and break every brick above it.

## Words

- **Ball**: the Ball Actor type.
- **Paddle**: the Paddle Actor type.
- **Brick**: the Brick Actor type; a **gold brick** is the GoldBrick Actor type, a kind of Brick.
- **Score** and **lives**: the Game Manager type.

## Playing

The left and right arrow keys slide the paddle along the bottom; it stops at the edges of the screen.

The ball launches up and to the right, quickly, as soon as the level starts. It bounces off the edges of the screen, with a sound, and off the paddle, which also speeds it up a little each time. When the ball gets too fast sideways, it is reined back in.

Each brick the ball hits breaks with a sound and adds 10 to the score. Gold bricks are worth more.

The score and the lives (three to start with) show in the top left corner. When the lives run out, the game is over.

## Levels

- **level-1**: four rows of nine bricks, with four gold bricks among them.

## Levels

- **level-1**: 36 bricks and 4 gold bricks to break.
